risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified and provides detailed segment, margin, cash flow, inventory, and litigation information. Credit risks include recurring net losses, customer and market concentration, weak defense and European demand, ongoing litigation costs, valuation allowances, and dependence on BBU cash flow to support other segments. Forward-looking estimates around demand, inventory reserves, litigation, and funding introduce uncertainty despite improving revenue, margins, backlog, and net loss.
